Motopp  IT Traineeship - 7 December 2026 Looking to start your IT career in the Netherlands as a refugee? The Motopp IT Traineeship offers a 6-month program with training and mentorship, preparing you for full-time roles at top companies like PwC, Rabobank, Alliander, Achmea and many others. Start your IT-career with Motopp Over the course of 29 weeks, you will prepare, together with eleven other trainees, for a career in the Dutch IT sector. How? Through a combination of technical IT skills training, insights into Dutch work culture, and workshops to develop essential soft skills. You will learn software development, gain an understanding of how the workplace operates in the Netherlands, and participate in sessions on topics such as presenting, assertiveness, and teamwork. The traineeship is fulltime and conducted in English. After completing the training, we will start mediation towards a paid job at one of our partner companies across the country. If we find a match, for the next 18 months we will continue to support you with personal coaching sessions, evaluations, and additional workshops. Step-by-Step Program - IT Bootcamp (14 weeks): Trainees develop technical skills and explore their ideal IT role. Topics covered are: Project Management, Requirements Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Back-end Development (Python, FastAPI), Testing, Cloud Computing, Software Testing, Information Security, Data analysis. - Internal Internship (13 weeks): Apply your knowledge in a simulated Dutch Agile work environment at Motopp, work on applications in Sprints, and receive feedback from trainers and mentors. - Professional skills: Learn about Dutch work culture, communication, presentation techniques, CV building, and get introduced to Agile/Scrum methodologies. - Career: We do not offer a 100% job guarantee, but we do offer 100% job intention.
